description: This file is an Entity Framework Core migration class that initializes the database schema for ASP.NET Core Identity, creating tables for roles, users, and related claims, logins, roles, and tokens.

classes.name: InitialIdentityModel
classes.description: A migration class derived from Migration that defines the schema changes to set up Identity tables in the database.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the operations to apply the migration, creating identity-related tables.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Defines the operations to revert the migration, dropping the identity-related tables.
